keyEvents.text: Goal! St. Louis City SC 0, San Diego 1. Anders Dreyer (San Diego) left footed shot from outside the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Alejandro Alvarado with a through ball following a fast break.
First Half ends, St. Louis City SC 0, San Diego 1.
Substitution, San Diego. David Vazquez replaces Bryan Zamblé.
Alejandro Alvarado (San Diego) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, St. Louis City SC. Tomás Ostrák replaces Jeong Sang-Bin.
Substitution, St. Louis City SC. Simon Becher replaces Rafael Navarro.
Substitution, St. Louis City SC. Fallou Fall replaces Daniel Edelman.
Delay in match (St. Louis City SC).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, San Diego. Gabriel Pirani replaces Pedro Soma.
Substitution, San Diego. Manu Duah replaces Ian Murphy.
Substitution, San Diego. Oscar Verhoeven replaces Kieran Sargeant.
Lukas MacNaughton (St. Louis City SC) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, St. Louis City SC. Damion Downs replaces Lukas MacNaughton.
Substitution, St. Louis City SC. Riley Lynch replaces Conrad Wallem.
Carlo Holse (St. Louis City SC) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, San Diego. Jeppe Tverskov replaces Anders Dreyer.
